events.title: PostReady: PR #620 — Remove duplicate "Choose from Post Packs" button from upload dropzone
events.description: Fixed a UX issue where the "Choose from Post Packs" button appeared twice in the upload dropzone, cleaning up the Upload tab after its redesign in PR #619.

events.title: PostReady: PR #621 — Placeholder art for the empty Video setup preview
events.description: Added placeholder art to the empty Video setup preview panel, giving users a clear visual cue that the preview will appear here once a video is generated.

events.title: PostReady: PR #622 — Fix top-align Batch settings panel with start of batch form
events.description: Fixed vertical alignment of the Batch settings panel so it top-aligns with the start of the batch form, improving layout consistency in the two-column workspace.

events.title: PostReady: PR #623 — Crop Video setup empty-state art to match Batch settings panel height
events.description: Fixed the Video setup panel's placeholder illustration which rendered as a tall block, pushing all content below it far down. Cropped and constrained the art so the Video panel now matches the compact Batch settings block height.

events.title: PostReady: PR #624 — Remove white card behind sidebar logo (dark lockup)
events.description: Fixed the dark sidebar logo: removed the white rounded card wrapping the wordmark so the logo sits directly on the black sidebar with the coral rocket mark, white Zippity text, and coral One — matching the owner's mockup.

events.title: PostReady: PR #625 — Use owner's single-raster dark sidebar lockup
events.description: Replaced the composed dark sidebar logo with the owner's preferred single-raster lockup — coral rocket speech-bubble + white "Zippity" + coral "One" — so the mark and wordmark are pixel-perfect every time.

events.title: PostReady: PR #626 — Coral H1 icons on Connect Socials, Settings & Post Packs
events.description: Added coral-colored H1 section icons to the Connect Socials, Settings, and Post Packs pages, providing visual consistency with the coral accent system across the dashboard.

events.title: PostReady: PR #627 — Stop How-it-works image flicker on mobile scroll
events.description: Fixed a mobile UX bug where the How-it-works section images would flicker during scroll, improving visual stability of the landing page on mobile devices.

events.title: PostReady: PR #628 — Restyle Schedule, Connect Socials and Settings to the create-area design system
events.description: Restyled the Schedule, Connect Socials, and Settings pages to use the same modern design system introduced in the Create page redesign, giving the full app a consistent visual language.

events.title: PostReady: PR #629 — Redesign post-detail page
events.description: Redesigned the post-detail ('Your post is ready') page to match the new create-area design system, giving the full posting flow a consistent visual identity.
